o.text: From bağ + -la. Cognate with Turkish bağlamak.
Borrowed from Arabic عُمُومًا (ʕumūman), adverbial accusative of عُمُوم (ʕumūm). By surface analysis, ümum + -ən.
From Proto-Turkic *ödleg (“time”), from Proto-Turkic *ödle-, from Proto-Turkic *öd (“time”).
From Persian بتر (batar), poetic form of بدتر (badtar), comparative form of Persian بد. Compare Ottoman Turkish بتر (beter).
Literally, “elephant bone”. Calque of Russian слоновая кость (slonovaja kostʹ).
